about_the_game:
INDOORS is a narrative-driven escape room for PC, where you’ll uncover mysteries long buried by time.

Step into the role of Rebecca, a time-traveling journalist working for Indoors LTD., newspaper of the paranormal and unexplainable. Your latest assignment: investigate the 1951 disappearance of the Alston family.

When your investigation is over, there’s still the tedious paperwork to handle before the next groundbreaking article makes headlines…

So sit back in your office, load the case slide into the projector, and prepare to see what unfolds.

✦ YOUR FIRST CASE: THE ALSTON FAMILY DISAPPEARANCE

Decades have passed since the Alston family, one of Britain’s most respected households, vanished from their mansion without a trace. The case was closed when the local police lost all of the original files.

Now it’s up to you to explore the halls of Alston Manor and search for clues that could finally reveal the truth behind the tragedy.

Supposedly, the manor is empty… but you might want to check your back every now and then.

✦ KEY FEATURES

  • Explore every corner and uncover the mansion’s hidden secrets.

  • Snap photos of crucial evidence with your mysterious camera.

  • Collect documents, notes, and records to piece the story together.

  • Identify the culprit among multiple suspects.

  • Time-traveling to the 1950s may have scrambled your mind!

  • Discover how this case connects to a deeper, overarching narrative.

name: INDOORS: The Alston Manor

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel i7 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: May 2, 1951. The night everyone in the Alston Manor vanished without a trace. As the newest reporter of a paranormal magazine, you are sent back to the night after the happening. Make your way through the mansion, solve puzzles, find evidence and uncover the truth behind the disappearance.
